phrases: 用于询问某事持续了多长时间
How long did the exam last?
How long did the meeting last?
How was the exam? Not too bad.
I think I passed in English.
I think I failed the French paper.
I could answer sixteen of the questions.
表示对某人来说太...（而不适合）
They were too difficult for me.
The exam was too hard for me.
The paper wasn't easy enough for me.
试卷对我来说不够简单。
表示做得还不错，不是很糟糕
Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
写一个字（强调什么都没写）

grammar.k: 一般过去时特殊疑问句
grammar.f: 疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？
grammar.d: 询问过去发生的事情的时间、原因、方式等信息的疑问句 用于询问过去动作的具体信息，如时间、原因等
ex: How long did the exam last?

grammar.f: too + 形容词 + (for sb) + to do sth / 形容词 + enough + (for sb) + to do sth
grammar.d: 表达'太...而不能'和'足够...可以'的含义 too...to表示否定含义，enough...to表示肯定含义
ex: They were too difficult for me.
The paper wasn't easy enough for me.
试卷对我来说不够简单。
The book is easy enough to read.
这本书足够简单，可以阅读。
He is too young to go to school.

grammar.k: 情态动词 could 的用法
grammar.f: 主语 + could + 动词原形
grammar.d: could 表示过去的能力或可能性 表示过去能够做某事（能力）或能够做到某事（可能性）
ex: I could answer sixteen of the questions.

patterns.p: How long did + 主语 + 动词原形 + (其他)?
o: How long did the exam last?
im: How long did the movie last?
How long did the trip last?

patterns.p: 主语 + think + 主语 + passed/failed + in + 科目
o: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
我想我英语和数学通过了。
im: I think I passed in History.
She thinks she failed in Physics.

patterns.p: too + 形容词 + for + 人称代词/名词
o: They were too difficult for me.
im: This problem is too hard for students.
这个问题对学生来说太难了。
The book is too boring for children.
这本书对孩子来说太无聊了。

patterns.p: 形容词 + enough + (for + 人称代词/名词) + to do sth
o: The English paper wasn't easy enough for me.
英语试卷对我来说不够简单。
im: The seat isn't comfortable enough for him.
这个座位对他来说不够舒服。
The room is big enough for five people.
这个房间足够大，可以容纳五个人。
